timeVaryingExclusion.constantMatrixSubstitution: If the declared instantaneous A,B still satisfy the frozen-style identity, the additional term is +1/2*z^T*Qdot*z; omitting it is invalid.
timeVaryingExclusion.physicalInductanceCaveat: A varying inductance also changes circuit dynamics through d(L*i)/dt=L*idot+Ldot*i. Therefore inserting only the chain-rule storage term into the old constant-L ODE is not a complete actuator-energy model.
timeVaryingExclusion.futureGate: Derive the full variable-parameter dynamics and signed actuator/control power port before any new admission; that extension is excluded from this attempt.
timeVaryingExclusion.sourceInputsAllowed: Arbitrary time-dependent source inputs u(t)=(Vs(t),F(t)) are permitted by the fixed-coefficient identity, with sufficient regularity for the stated derivative. The exclusion concerns time-varying model parameters/coefficients, not source waveforms.
